attchmntText: Vertoz Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the Netherlands.

Sarveshwar Foods Limited has submitted to the Exchange regrading the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results along with limited review Report for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.
